title: Only
summary: ONLY, adjective 1. Single; one along; as, John was the only man present. 2. This and no other. This is an only child. 3. This above all others. He is the only man for music. ONLY, adverb 1. Singly; me

inlines.v: ONLY, adjective 1. Single; one along; as, John was the only man present. 2. This and no other. This is an only child. 3. This above all others. He is the only man for music. ONLY, adverb 1. Singly; merely; barely; in one manner or for one purpose along. I purpose my thoughts only as conjectures. And to be loved himself, needs only to be known. 2. This and no other wise. Every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually. Genesis 6:5. 3. Singly; without more; as only-begotten.
